rows.question: What is name of the country that speaks the largest number of languages?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT c.Name AS Name,
       clc.language_count AS language_count
FROM country AS c
JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode,
         COUNT(DISTINCT Language) AS language_count
  FROM countrylanguage
  GROUP BY CountryCode
) AS clc ON c.Code = clc.CountryCode
ORDER BY clc.language_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Give the name of the nation that uses the greatest amount of languages.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(*) AS language_count
  FROM countrylanguage
  GROUP BY CountryCode
) clc ON clc.CountryCode = c.Code
WHERE clc.language_count = (
  SELECT MAX(language_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(*) AS language_count
    FROM countrylanguage
    GROUP BY CountryCode
  )
)
